tall-fescue.reason: Other fescue sowing seed; neither meadow nor red fescue. No allocation to Festuca arundinacea.

subterranean-clover.reason: Trifolium spp. sowing seed excluding Trifolium pratense; no allocation to Trifolium subterraneum.

white-sweetclover.reason: Forage sowing seed residual group only for declared forage use; Melilotus albus is not Trifolium. Other uses are outside this mapping.

yellow-sweetclover.reason: Forage sowing seed residual group only for declared forage use; Melilotus officinalis is not Trifolium. Other uses are outside this mapping.

camelina.reason: Other oil seeds for sowing, after named exclusions. Camelina sativa is an oilseed; no species share is calculated.

niger.reason: Other oil seeds for sowing, after named exclusions. Guizotia abyssinica is an oilseed; no species share is calculated.

maize.reason: Four grain-maize seed classes plus hybrid sweetcorn seed. Zea mays scope is explicit but non-hybrid sweetcorn has no sowing-only code; retained partial coverage.

sorghum.reason: Grain sorghum sowing seed; does not establish coverage for every forage Sorghum bicolor use or Sudan/hybrid grass group.

beet-chard.reason: Separate sugar, fodder and salad beet sowing classes for Beta vulgaris. Chard seed scope is not inferred; each customs class remains separate.

rice.reason: CN describes rice seed without limiting it to Oryza sativa. FAO documents two cultivated rice species, Oryza sativa and Oryza glaberrima. No species-specific restriction or share inferred.

review_reason: End-use/customs-boundary ambiguity requires official classification evidence beyond botanical name or SeedTrade category. No trade activation.
vegetable_reason: Vegetable sowing seed under 12099180, excluding beet and separately classified legumes, cereals, spices and oilseeds. This is a customs group, never species-specific trade. Original botanical identity and vegetable seed use are retained.
